paragraphs: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. was incorporated in Bermuda on March 17, 2021, pursuant to the Companies Act 1981 of Bermuda, as an exempted company limited by shares. Himalaya Shipping Ltd. was founded for the purpose of owning high-quality Newcastlemax dry bulk vessels, each with capacity in the range of 210,000 dead weight tons ("dwt") which are equipped with the latest generation dual fuel LNG technology. We and our subsidiaries have twelve vessels in operation.

We are listed on the New York Stock Exchange and on the Euronext Oslo Bors under the symbol "HSHP." Our common shares were introduced to the Euronext Growth Oslo and on April 29, 2022, our shares were listed on the Euronext Expand. Our shares started trading on Euronext Oslo Bors on June 3, 2025, following the transfer of our listing from Euronext Expand. Since our IPO in April 2023, our common shares are listed for trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Our principal executive offices are located at S. E. Pearman Building, 2nd Floor, 9 Par-la-Ville Road, Hamilton HM11, Bermuda and our telephone number is +1 (441) 542-4577.
Our current agent in the United States is Puglisi & Associates upon whom process may be served in any action brought against us under the laws of the United States.

The SEC maintains an internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC, which can be found at http://www.sec.gov. Our internet address is https://himalaya-shipping.com/. The information contained on our website is not incorporated by reference into, and does not form part of, this annual report.
We operate twelve Newcastlemax dry bulk vessels.

headings: C. Reasons for the Offer and Use of Proceeds
Risks Related to Our Relationship with 2020 Bulkers Management and our Ship Managers
Risks Related to Our Common Shares
We charter our vessels on time charters in a volatile shipping industry and a decline in charter hire rates could affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.

We depend upon a limited number of significant customers for a large part of our revenues and the loss of one or more of these customers could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Rising crew costs, inflation, and their connected increase in wages could adversely affect our results of operations.
Liquidity risk could impair our ability to fund operations and jeopardize our financial condition, growth and prospects.

We are subject to risks with respect to our counterparties on contracts, and failure of such counterparties to meet their obligations could cause us to suffer losses or negatively impact our business.
We may be subject to litigation that, if not resolved in our favor or covered by insurance, could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
We are a holding company, and we depend on our subsidiaries to distribute or loan funds to us in order to satisfy our financial obligations include making dividend payments.
As an exempted company incorporated under Bermuda law, our operations may be subject to economic substance requirements.
We depend on our Manager to operate our business and our business could be harmed if our Manager or the Ship Managers fail to perform their services satisfactorily.
We are dependent on our Ship Managers and their ability to hire and retain key personnel.
Our contracted Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer do not devote all of their time to our business, which may hinder our ability to operate successfully.
We may be subject to U.S. federal income tax on U.S. source income, which may reduce our earnings.
If we are classified as a "passive foreign investment company," U.S. Holders of our common shares may be subject to adverse U.S. federal income tax consequences.

paragraphs: The following discussion of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the sections of this Annual Report entitled "Item 4. Information on the Company" and our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto, included herein. Our financial statements have been prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP. This discussion includes forward-looking statements based on assumptions about our future business. You should also review the section of this Annual Report entitled "Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and "Item 3. Key Information—D. Risk Factors" for a discussion of important factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from the results described in or implied by certain forward-looking statements.
In 2025, we drew down $6.0 million under our Drew Holdings RCF which was fully repaid in March 2025. As of March 5, 2026, we have $10.0 million available to draw down from this facility.

In December 2025, the Company entered into an addendum in relation to the Drew Holdings RCF, to extend the timeframe to drawdown from the facility to December 31, 2026 and the latest repayment date to December 31, 2027.

In March 2025, the Company issued 2,650,000 common shares of par value $1.00 each in a private placement at a price of $5.73 per share, raising net proceeds of $14.8 million to be used for general corporate purposes.
In April 2025, the Board approved a grant of 200,000 share options to key employees, including contracted management.
We declared cash distributions totaling $0.57 per common share in 2025. The cash distributions were made from the Company's Contributed Surplus account.

In December 2025, in connection with the exercise of share options under the long-term incentive plan, the Company issued 100,000 common shares of par value $1.00 each at the exercise price of $7.05 per share.
See Note 19 - "Shareholders' Equity," and Note 20 - "Subsequent events" of our audited Consolidated Financial Statements included herein, for further information.
On April 1, 2025, Lars-Christian Svensen commenced his role as contracted Chief Executive Officer and Vidar Hasund was appointed contracted Chief Financial Officer.
Our shares started trading on Euronext Oslo Bors on June 3, 2025 following the transfer of our listing from Euronext
Expand. Our shares are also listed on the NYSE.
We declared cash distributions totaling $0.25 per common share in January, February and March 2026.

In February 2026, in connection with the exercise of share options under the long-term incentive plan, the Company issued 100,000 common shares of par value $1.00 each at the exercise price of $6.76 per share.

On February 9, 2026, the Company entered into a contract with 2020 Bulkers Ltd. to purchase an additional 4,200 shares in 2020 Bulkers Management for NOK1.1 million, which will be effective on April 1, 2026. This will increase our ownership in 2020 Bulkers Management from 40% to 54%.

paragraphs: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. 於 2021 年 3 月 17 日根據伯爾緒亞 1981 年公司法成立，為豁免公司，股份有限公司。Himalaya Shipping Ltd. 成立之目的為擁有高品質之 Newcastlemax 幹散貨船，每艘船之載重能力約為 210,000 死重噸（"dwt"），並裝備最新一代雙燃料 LNG 技術。我們與我們之子公司目前共有十二艘船隻在運作。

我們於紐約證券交易所及歐洲證券交易所奧斯陸證券交易所上市，股票代碼為 "HSHP"。我們之普通股於歐洲證券交易所成長市場上市，並於 2022 年 4 月 29 日，我們之股票於歐洲證券交易所擴展市場上市。我們之股票於 2025 年 6 月 3 日開始在歐洲證券交易所奧斯洛證券交易所交易，此為我們從歐洲證券交易所擴展市場轉移上市後之結果。自我們於 2023 年 4 月進行首次公開發行以來，我們之普通股已在紐約證券交易所上市交易。
我們之主要營業據點位於 S. E. Pearman 建築物，2 樓，9 Par-la-Ville 街道，哈密爾頓 HM11，伯爾緒亞，我們之電話號碼為 +1 (441) 542-4577。
我們於美國之代理人為 Puglisi & Associates，任何針對我們在美國法律下提起之訴訟，均可向其送達法律程序。
美國證券交易委員會（SEC）維護一個網際網路網站，該網站包含向 SEC 提交電子檔之發行人的報告、股東權益說明書及資訊聲明等資料，可至 http://www.sec.gov 查閱。我們之網站地址為 https://himalaya-shipping.com/。本網站所載資訊並未納入本年度報告之參考，亦不構成本年度報告之一部分。

paragraphs: 以下對本公司財務狀況及營運成果之討論，應配合本年度年報中「第 4 項資訊—公司資訊」及本公司合併財務報表及其附註之相關部分一併閱讀。本公司財務報表係依美國會計準則（U.S. GAAP）編製。本討論包含基於對本公司未來業務之假設所作出之預測性陳述。您亦應審閱本年度年報中「預測性陳述之警示聲明」及「第 3 項重要資訊—D. 風險因素」部分，以瞭解可能導致本公司實際結果與預測性陳述中所描述或暗示之結果有重大差異之重要因素。
2025 年，本公司自 Drew Holdings RCF 提款 6.0 百萬美元，該筆貸款於 2025 年 3 月全數償還。截至 2026 年 3 月 5 日，本公司自該融資安排可提款之金額為 10.0 百萬美元。
2025 年 12 月，本公司就 Drew Holdings RCF 簽訂附加條款，將自該融資安排提款之期限延長至 2026 年 12 月 31 日，並將最後償還日期延長至 2027 年 12 月 31 日。
2025 年 3 月，本公司發行 2,650,000 仟元面額為 1.00 美元之普通股，於私人家族投資中以每股 5.73 美元之價格發行，籌得淨資金 14.8 百萬美元，用途為一般營運用途。
2025 年 4 月，董事會批准向關鍵員工（包括合約管理人員）發放 200,000 仟股選擇權。
本公司於 2025 年宣告現金分紅，每股為 0.57 美元。該筆現金分紅係自本公司之資本餘額帳戶支應。
2025 年 12 月，本公司因長期激勵計畫下之股票選擇權兌換，發行 100,000 仟元面額為 1.00 美元之普通股，每股兌換價格為 7.05 美元。
有關更多資訊，請參閱本年報所附之經審計合併財務報表之附註 19—「股東權益」及附註 20—「後續事件」。
2025年4月1日，Lars-Christian Svensen 開始擔任合約首席執行長，Vidar Hasund 被任命為合約首席財務長。
我們的股票於2025年6月3日開始在Euronext Oslo Bors交易，這是因為我們的上市地從Euronext轉移過來。
Expand. 我們的股票也於紐約證券交易所（NYSE）上市。
我們於2026年1月、2月及3月宣告現金分派，總計每股0.25美元。
2026年2月，根據長期激勵計劃下股票選擇權的行權，本公司發行了100,000股普通股，每股面值1.00美元，行權價格為每股6.76美元。
2026年2月9日，本公司與2020 Bulkers Ltd. 簽訂合同，購買2020 Bulkers Management額外4,200股，總價為1.1百萬挪威克朗，該交易將於2026年4月1日生效。此交易將使本公司在2020 Bulkers Management的持股比例從40%提高至54%。

headings: C. 發行股票之原因及資金用途
與本公司業務相關之風險
與本公司與 2020 Bulkers Management 及我們之船舶管理機構之關係相關之風險
與本公司負債相關之風險
我們在波動的運輸業中以期租約方式租用船舶，若租賃費率下降，可能影響我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況。
我們的收入有很大一部分依賴少數重要客戶，若失去其中一個或數個客戶，可能對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
船員費用上漲、通貨膨脹及其相關的工資增加，可能對我們的營運結果造成不利影響。
流動性風險可能影響我們資金營運的能力，並危及我們的財務狀況、成長與前景。
我們面臨與合約對方相關的風險，若這些合約對方無法履行其義務，可能導致我們遭受損失或對我們的業務造成負面影響。
我們可能面臨訴訟，若無法有利解決或獲得保險賠償，可能對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
本公司為一間控股公司，我們依賴我們的子公司將資金分紅或貸款給我們，以履行我們的財務義務，包括發放股息。
作為根據伯明翰法規設立的豁免公司，我們的業務可能受到經濟實質要求的影響。
我們依賴我們的經理人來經營我們的業務，若經理人或船舶經理人未能妥善履行其服務，可能對我們的業務造成損害。
我們依賴我們的船舶經理人及其聘僱與留任關鍵人員的能力。
我們的合約首席執行長與首席財務長並未全數投入我們的業務，這可能影響我們成功運作的能力。
我們可能需就美國來源所得繳納美國聯邦所得稅，這可能會降低我們的盈餘。
若我們被歸類為「被動外國投資公司」，美國投資人持有我們的普通股可能面臨不利的美國聯邦所得稅後果。
